qemu_intent.drive: ephemeral qcow2 overlay over verified pinned Debian base

fdt_discovery_contract.reason: Runtime discovery must consume the QEMU-provided FDT and must not hard-code QEMU platform-bus addresses into common policy.

positive_vectors: one discovered VirtIO MMIO node with bounded nonzero reg range
supported device id resolves to block transport
feature negotiation selects only implemented features
bounded queue setup and one sector read
bounded queue setup and one sector write to disposable overlay
negative_vectors: guest buffer outside explicitly mediated range
device reset/teardown followed by stale descriptor completion
security_invariants: no descriptor can address arbitrary kernel memory
device teardown revokes queue/IRQ/shared-buffer authority before reuse
block transport does not own filesystem policy
pinned Debian base image is never written directly

fallback.trigger: VirtIO-MMIO cannot meet correctness/security acceptance with the smaller QEMU-only path
fallback.rule: Fallback must explicitly release the required PCIe/IRQ/DMA lanes; no silent widening.
